about: Hero Motors designs and makes powertrain solutions (gears and transmissions, e-bike CVT hubs, motors and drive units) and alloys and metallics components such as sheet metal and tubular assemblies. It supplies two-wheeler, e-bike, motorsport and performance-auto OEMs in India, Europe, the US and ASEAN from six plants across India, the UK and Thailand. Revenue was Rs 1,188 crore in FY26, with 41% from international customers and 23% from EV/e-mobility.
sector: Auto Components - Powertrain and Alloys & Metallics
headquarters: Ludhiana, Punjab (registered office); operations led from Noida

objects.purpose: Repayment/prepayment of certain borrowings of the Company
Capex for equipment to expand capacity at Gautam Buddha Nagar (UP) facility
Unidentified acquisitions, strategic initiatives and general corporate purposes

promoters.background: Munjal family (Hero Motors Company group). Pankaj Munjal, Chairman, has over 37 years in automotive and bicycle industries and leads the group that includes Hero Cycles. O P Munjal Holdings sells Rs 395 crore of shares in the OFS; promoter group member Hero Cycles sells Rs 5 crore. No promoter shares pledged.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 72.89% of FY26 revenue (78.03% FY25, 76.96% FY24). Europe was 33.59% of FY26 revenue; India 58.64%.

litigation_note: Contingent liabilities at Mar-26 are small: labour cases Rs 0.99 cr, other claims Rs 0.23 cr, bank guarantees Rs 2.11 cr, income tax Rs 0.16 cr; capital commitments Rs 24.42 cr. Minor statutory payment delays (PF, ESI, TDS) disclosed.
strengths: India's leading supplier to the global e-mobility industry; EV/e-mobility revenue rose from 12.03% to 23.00% of sales in two years.
Only player making and exporting CVT hubs for global e-bike OEMs from India and only maker of integrated e-bike powertrains in India (per CRISIL).
Premium customer base including BMW, Ducati, Hero MotoCorp and motorsport players; high switching costs once orders are won.
Diversified footprint: six plants across India, UK and Thailand, plus design and technology centres; 41% of revenue is from international customers.
Strong R&D focus at 7.54% of revenue in FY26, enabling full design-to-production system offerings rather than make-to-print work.
Profits and margins improving: PAT up from Rs 17 crore to Rs 41 crore in two years; EBITDA margin up from 8.11% to 12.44%.
Experienced promoter group and management; CRISIL A+/Stable credit rating on bank facilities.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on top 10 customers
risks.detail: Top 10 customers contributed 72.89% of FY26 revenue (78.03% in FY25). Loss of any major customer would hurt sales and profits.

risks.title: Expensive valuation versus earnings
risks.detail: At the Rs 84 cap price the IPO is at 73.04x FY26 basic EPS of Rs 1.15, against peer average P/E of 50.20 and a RoNW of only 8.53%.

risks.title: Thin profit margins and leverage
risks.detail: PAT margin is just 3.46%; borrowings are about Rs 401 crore with net debt/Adjusted EBITDA of 2.24x and current ratio 0.94. Rs 190 crore of IPO money goes to debt repayment.

risks.title: Exposure to Europe and overseas markets
risks.detail: Europe contributed 33.59% of FY26 revenue (28.45% in FY25); adverse events in these jurisdictions could reduce revenue.

risks.title: Reliance on e-bike and two-wheeler industries
risks.detail: Business depends on the e-bike, two-wheeler and motorsport sectors in India and overseas; a downturn would directly cut sales.

risks.title: Limited set of suppliers for critical raw materials
risks.detail: The company relies on few suppliers and has no definitive supply agreements with all of them; supply interruptions could affect output and costs.

risks.title: Customer quality and delivery requirements
risks.detail: Strict performance standards could lead to recalls, warranty claims, lower business share or cancelled orders if not met.

risks.title: Volatile operating cash flow and unappraised use of funds
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was Rs 48 crore in FY25 versus Rs 144 crore in FY26; Rs 172 crore of proceeds is for unidentified acquisitions and general corporate purposes, not appraised by any agency.

notes: FY26 audited, restated consolidated; amounts converted from Rs million. EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA are company-reported; Adjusted EBITDA adds back non-cash ESOP cost of Rs 10.50 cr (FY26), 14.82 cr (FY25), 39.46 cr (FY24). net_worth is total equity incl. NCI; reserves is other equity attributable to owners; borrowings = current + non-current (excl. leases); cash_and_bank = cash and equivalents + other bank balances. ROCE/RoNW/ROE are as reported in the Prospectus; debt_equity and current_ratio are computed from the balance sheet. pe_pre_ipo is on basic EPS at cap price (diluted 73.68x). Offer price fixed at Rs 84 (cap). No employee reservation disclosed. Peer CIE Automotive figures are calendar-year.
